topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: The rain's been pourin' down like it's trying to wash away the last of the good stuff, but some things, they stick around, no matter how much water you throw at 'em. Like memories. Got a call from this fella, voice tight like a drum, talkin' 'bout a tree. One he planted, he says, as a kid. Now it's gone, cut clean out of the ground like it never took root at all. He's askin' me to find out who done it, like maybe, just maybe, I can bring back a piece of his childhood. It's the kind of case that's more about the heart than the badge, and that's the kind that keeps you up at night, rain drummin' on the window. I told him I'd look into it, but I already know what I'm gonna find. Nothing lasts, not in this town. Not even the roots we think run the deepest.
